verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is SDK/API-first. Every documented capability is exposed programmatically, with no UI-only path in evidence: sandbox creation via getSandbox, exec with streaming and stdin, file read/write/mkdir/watch, code interpreter contexts, sessions, preview URLs and tunnels, bucket mounts, snapshots, and WebSocket terminals. A Cloudflare-wide OpenAPI spec and llms.txt are also published. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of API/dashboard parity, evidence that sandbox-specific lifecycle and management operations are covered in the OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
